description: TRUST European transport model provides a European multimodal network model assigning passenger and freight demand to road, rail and shipping links. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: National calibration to Eurostat totals is provider-reported. Underlying model files and current base year were not obtained. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
